Multiple Imputation S3 Object to List of Multiply Imputed Data Sets

Source: R/miHelper-mi2-list.R
MI2List.Rd

Multiple Imputation S3 Object to List of Multiply Imputed Data Sets

Usage

MI2List(object)

Arguments

object

Object of class mids or amelia.

Value

Returns a list of data frames.

See also

Other Multiple Imputation Helper Functions: MICombine(), MIFit()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

# mice --------------------------------------
mids <- mice::mice(airquality, m = 5)
